mapper.insert: INSERT INTO investment_product_catalog ( product_type, product_code, isin_code, product_name, provider_name, category, source_type, active, last_synced_at ) VALUES ( #{productType}, #{productCode}, #{isinCode}, #{productName}, #{providerName}, #{category}, #{sourceType}, #{active}, #{lastSyncedAt} ) AS incoming ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE investment_product_id = LAST_INSERT_ID(investment_product_catalog.investment_product_id), isin_code = incoming.isin_code, product_name = incoming.product_name, provider_name = incoming.provider_name, category = incoming.category, source_type = incoming.source_type, active = incoming.active, last_synced_at = incoming.last_synced_at

INSERT INTO etf_product_detail ( investment_product_id, price_base_date, closing_price, previous_day_change, fluctuation_rate, nav, opening_price, high_price, low_price, trading_volume, trading_value, listed_share_count, market_cap, net_asset_total_amount, base_index_name, base_index_close ) VALUES ( #{investmentProductId}, #{priceBaseDate}, #{closingPrice}, #{previousDayChange}, #{fluctuationRate}, #{nav}, #{openingPrice}, #{highPrice}, #{lowPrice}, #{tradingVolume}, #{tradingValue}, #{listedShareCount}, #{marketCap}, #{netAssetTotalAmount}, #{baseIndexName}, #{baseIndexClose} ) AS incoming ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE price_base_date = incoming.price_base_date, closing_price = incoming.closing_price, previous_day_change = incoming.previous_day_change, fluctuation_rate = incoming.fluctuation_rate, nav = incoming.nav, opening_price = incoming.opening_price, high_price = incoming.high_price, low_price = incoming.low_price, trading_volume = incoming.trading_volume, trading_value = incoming.trading_value, listed_share_count = incoming.listed_share_count, market_cap = incoming.market_cap, net_asset_total_amount = incoming.net_asset_total_amount, base_index_name = incoming.base_index_name, base_index_close = incoming.base_index_close
mapper.select:
SELECT
FROM investment_product_catalog c INNER JOIN etf_product_detail d ON d.investment_product_id = c.investment_product_id WHERE c.product_type = 'ETF' AND c.active = 1
AND ( c.product_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR c.product_code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR d.base_index_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') )
ORDER BY d.market_cap DESC, c.product_name ASC
ORDER BY d.fluctuation_rate DESC, c.product_name ASC
ORDER BY c.product_name ASC
ORDER BY d.trading_value DESC, c.product_name ASC
LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT
FROM investment_product_catalog c INNER JOIN etf_product_detail d ON d.investment_product_id = c.investment_product_id WHERE c.product_type = 'ETF' AND c.active = 1 AND c.investment_product_id = #{investmentProductId}
SELECT MAX(d.price_base_date) FROM etf_product_detail d INNER JOIN investment_product_catalog c ON c.investment_product_id = d.investment_product_id WHERE c.product_type = 'ETF' AND c.active = 1
